description.en: Sizzling stone bowl filled with warm rice, seasoned namul vegetables, marinated beef, fried egg, and spicy gochujang.
description.tr: Sıcak taş kasede servis edilen pirinç, marine dana eti, sotelenmiş sebzeler, yumurta ve acı gochujang soslu karışım.
description.es: Bol de piedra caliente con arroz, verduras namul salteadas, ternera marinada, huevo y gochujang.
description.de: Heißer Steintopf mit Reis, mariniertem Rindfleisch, Namul-Gemüse, Spiegelei und Gochujang.

ingredients.en: Spinach, bean sprouts, carrots, shiitake mushrooms, zucchini
ingredients.tr: Ispanak, soya filizi, havuç, shiitake mantarı, kabak
ingredients.es: Espinacas, brotes de soja, zanahorias, setas shiitake, calabacín

ingredients.en: Gochujang (Korean chili paste), sesame oil, eggs
ingredients.tr: Gochujang (Kore acı biber ezmesi), susam yağı, yumurta

steps.en: Blanch and season spinach and bean sprouts with sesame oil and garlic.
steps.tr: Ispanak ve soya filizini haşlayıp sarımsak ve susam yağıyla tatlandırın.
steps.es: Escaldar espinacas y brotes de soja; aliñar con aceite de sésamo y ajo.
steps.de: Spinat und Sojasprossen blanchieren und mit Sesamöl und Knoblauch anmachen.

steps.en: Sauté julienned carrots, zucchini, and sliced shiitake mushrooms individually.
steps.tr: Jülyen havuç, kabak ve mantarları ayrı ayrı tavada soteleyin.
steps.es: Saltear por separado zanahorias en juliana, calabacín y setas shiitake.
steps.de: Karotten, Zucchini und Shiitake-Pilze nacheinander kurz anbraten.

steps.en: Sear marinated beef and fry eggs sunny-side up.
steps.tr: Marine dana etini soteleyin ve göz yumurta pişirin.
steps.es: Cocinar la ternera marinada y freír huevos con la yema tierna.
steps.de: Mariniertes Rindfleisch anbraten und Spiegeleier braten.

steps.en: Oil a hot stone bowl, layer rice, arrange toppings radially, top with egg, and serve with gochujang sauce.
steps.tr: Sıcak kaseyi yağlayın, pirinci koyup malzemeleri renk sırasına göre dizin, yumurta ve gochujang ile servis edin.
steps.es: Aceitar el bol caliente, poner arroz, disponer los ingredientes, coronar con huevo y gochujang.
steps.de: Heißen Steintopf einölen, Reis einfüllen, Zutaten fächerförmig anrichten, Ei und Gochujang daraufgeben.

description.en: Ultra-crispy double-fried chicken coated in a sticky, sweet, and spicy red chili glaze.
description.tr: İki kez kızartılarak ultra çıtır yapılan, tatlı ve acı yapışkan sosla kaplanan Kore kızarmış tavuğu.
description.es: Pollo ultra crujiente con doble fritura bañado en una salsa dulce y picante coreana.
description.de: Ultra-knuspriges, doppelt frittiertes Hähnchen in einer klebrig-süß-scharfen roten Chiliglasur.

ingredients.en: Potato starch or cornstarch (for light crunchy crust)
Gochujang, ketchup, honey, brown sugar, garlic
ingredients.tr: Gochujang, ketçap, bal, esmer şeker, sarımsak
ingredients.es: Gochujang, kétchup, miel, azúcar moreno, ajo
ingredients.de: Gochujang, Ketchup, Honig, brauner Zucker, Knoblauch

ingredients.en: Toasted sesame seeds and crushed peanuts
ingredients.tr: Kavrulmuş susam ve kırık yer fıstığı
ingredients.es: Semillas de sésamo y cacahuetes picados

steps.en: Season chicken with ginger, salt, and pepper, then dredge thoroughly in potato starch.
steps.tr: Tavukları zencefil ve tuzla baharatlayıp patates nişastasına bulayın.
steps.es: Sazonar el pollo con jengibre y sal, luego rebozar bien en fécula de patata.
steps.de: Hähnchen mit Ingwer und Salz würzen, gründlich in Stärke wenden.

steps.en: First fry at 165°C for 7-8 minutes until cooked through; rest for 5 minutes.
steps.tr: İlk turda 165°C yağda 7-8 dakika kızartın; 5 dakika dinlendirin.
steps.es: Primera fritura a 165°C durante 7-8 minutos; reposar 5 minutos.
steps.de: Erste Fritüre bei 165°C für 7-8 Minuten; 5 Minuten ruhen lassen.

steps.en: Simmer gochujang, ketchup, honey, and garlic in a pan until sticky and glossy.
steps.tr: Gochujang, ketçap, bal ve sarımsağı tavada koyulaşana kadar kaynatın.
steps.es: Cocinar gochujang, kétchup, miel y ajo hasta que la salsa espese.
steps.de: Gochujang, Ketchup, Honig und Knoblauch zu einer glänzenden Sauce einkochen.

steps.en: Second fry at 190°C for 2 minutes for shattering crunch; immediately toss in hot glaze.
steps.tr: İkinci turda 190°C kızgın yağda 2 dakika çıtırlaştırıp hemen sıcak sosla harmanlayın.
steps.es: Segunda fritura a 190°C durante 2 minutos; bañar de inmediato en la salsa.
steps.de: Zweite Fritüre bei 190°C für 2 Minuten für maximale Knusprigkeit; sofort in der Sauce wenden.

description.en: Deeply comforting spicy stew made with aged fermented kimchi, pork belly, tofu, and anchovy broth.
description.tr: Olgunlaşmış fermente kimçi, dana/domuz eti, tofu ve acı pul biberle kaynatılan geleneksel Kore güveci.
description.es: Guiso coreano reconfortante y picante con kimchi fermentado, panceta y tofu.
description.de: Wärmender, würziger Eintopf aus gut gereiftem Kimchi, Schweinebauch und Tofu in Anchovis-Brühe.

ingredients.tr: 300g iyice olgunlaşmış ekşi kimçi ve suyu
ingredients.es: 300g kimchi bien fermentado y su jugo
ingredients.de: 300g gut gereifter, saurer Kimchi mit Saft

ingredients.en: Gochugaru (Korean chili flakes), garlic, scallions, anchovy broth
ingredients.tr: Gochugaru (Kore pul biberi), sarımsak, taze soğan, hamsi suyu
ingredients.es: Gochugaru, ajo, cebolleta, caldo de anchoas

steps.en: Sauté pork belly with chopped aged kimchi in sesame oil until pork is browned.
steps.tr: Eti ve doğranmış kimçiyi susam yağında hafifçe kavurun.
steps.es: Saltear la panceta con el kimchi picado en aceite de sésamo.
steps.de: Schweinebauch mit gehacktem Kimchi in Sesamöl anbraten.

steps.en: Add anchovy-kelp broth and kimchi juice; bring to a vigorous boil.
steps.tr: Hamsi suyunu ve kimçi suyunu ekleyip hızlıca kaynatın.
steps.es: Agregar caldo de anchoas y jugo de kimchi; llevar a ebullición.
steps.de: Anchovis-Fond und Kimchisaft zugießen; kräftig aufkochen.

steps.en: Add gochugaru and minced garlic; lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
steps.tr: Gochugaru ve sarımsağı ekleyin; ateşi kısıp 20 dakika demlendirin.
steps.es: Añadir gochugaru y ajo; cocinar a fuego lento durante 20 minutos.
steps.de: Gochugaru und Knoblauch zufügen; 20 Minuten sanft köcheln lassen.

steps.en: Add tofu slices and scallions; simmer 5 more minutes and serve boiling hot with rice.
steps.tr: Tofu dilimlerini ve taze soğanları ekleyin; 5 dakika daha pişirip sıcak pilavla sunun.
steps.es: Agregar tofu y cebolleta; cocinar 5 minutos más y servir muy caliente.
steps.de: Tofuscheiben und Frühlingszwiebeln zugeben; 5 Minuten weiterköcheln und kochend heiß servieren.

description.en: Thinly sliced marinated prime beef grilled to smoky caramelized perfection with sweet pear and soy marinade.
description.tr: Tatlı Kore armudu, soya sosu ve sarımsakla marine edilmiş incecik ızgara dana eti.
description.es: Finas láminas de ternera marinadas con pera coreana, soja y sésamo, asadas a fuego vivo.
description.de: Hauchdünn geschnittenes Rindfleisch mariniert in Sojasauce, Birne und Sesam, saftig gegrillt.

ingredients.en: 600g beef sirloin or ribeye, sliced paper-thin
ingredients.es: 600g solomillo de ternera en láminas finísimas

ingredients.en: Grated Asian pear or apple, soy sauce, brown sugar
ingredients.tr: Rendelenmiş Asya armudu veya elma, soya sosu, esmer şeker
ingredients.es: Pera asiática rallada, salsa de soja, azúcar moreno

ingredients.en: Toasted sesame oil, minced garlic, scallions, black pepper
ingredients.tr: Kavrulmuş susam yağı, sarımsak, taze soğan, karabiber
ingredients.es: Aceite de sésamo, ajo picado, cebolletas, pimienta

steps.en: Blend pear, soy sauce, sugar, garlic, and sesame oil into a smooth marinade.
steps.tr: Armut, soya sosu, şeker, sarımsak ve susam yağını blenderdan geçirip marine sosu yapın.
steps.es: Triturar pera, soja, azúcar, ajo y aceite de sésamo para el marinado.
steps.de: Birne, Sojasauce, Zucker, Knoblauch und Sesamöl zur Marinade pürieren.

steps.en: Coat beef slices in marinade and chill for at least 1 hour.
steps.tr: Et dilimlerini sosa bulayın ve buzdolabında en az 1 saat bekletin.
steps.es: Marinar la carne en la mezcla durante al menos 1 hora.
steps.de: Rindfleischstreifen in der Marinade mindestens 1 Stunde ziehen lassen.

steps.en: Sear quickly on a screaming-hot grill plate or cast iron skillet without overcrowding.
steps.tr: Çok sıcak ızgarada veya döküm tavada eti suyunu saldırmadan hızla mühürleyin.
steps.es: Cocinar rápidamente en sartén muy caliente o parrilla para caramelizar.
steps.de: Auf sehr heißem Grill oder in Gusseisenpfanne portionsweise scharf anbraten.

steps.en: Serve wrapped in fresh lettuce leaves (ssam) with ssamjang and rice.
steps.tr: Taze marul yapraklarına (ssam) sararak ssamjang sosu ve pilavla tüketin.
steps.es: Servir envuelto en hojas de lechuga fresca con salsa ssamjang.
steps.de: In frischen Salatblättern mit Ssamjang-Sauce und Reis servieren.

description.en: Chewy cylindrical Korean rice cakes simmered in a sweet and fiery gochujang chili broth with fish cakes.
description.tr: Tatlı ve acı gochujang sosunda pişen çiğnenebilir lokum kıvamında Kore silindir pirinç kekleri.
description.es: Pasteles de arroz cilíndricos coreanos en una salsa picante y dulce de gochujang con pastel de pescado.
description.de: Zähe zylindrische Reiskuchen in einer feurig-süßen Gochujang-Sauce mit Fischkuchen gekocht.

ingredients.es: Pastel de pescado coreano en tiras

ingredients.en: Gochujang, gochugaru, sugar, corn syrup, soy sauce
ingredients.tr: Gochujang, gochugaru pul biber, şeker, mısır şurubu, soya
ingredients.es: Gochujang, gochugaru, azúcar, jarabe de maíz, soja

ingredients.tr: Hamsi suyu, taze soğan, haşlanmış yumurta
ingredients.es: Caldo de anchoas, cebolletas, huevos cocidos

steps.en: Soak rice cakes in warm water for 10 minutes if refrigerated.
steps.tr: Pirinç keklerini 10 dakika ılık suda bekletin.
steps.es: Remojar los pasteles de arroz en agua tibia durante 10 minutos.
steps.de: Reiskuchen 10 Minuten in warmem Wasser einweichen.

steps.en: Boil anchovy broth in a shallow pan, whisk in gochujang, gochugaru, and sweeteners.
steps.tr: Geniş tavada hamsi suyunu kaynatıp gochujang ve şekeri çırpın.
steps.es: Hervir el caldo de anchoas y disolver gochujang, gochugaru y azúcar.
steps.de: Anchovis-Fond aufkochen, Gochujang, Gochugaru und Süßungsmittel einrühren.

steps.en: Add rice cakes and sliced fish cakes; simmer on medium heat stirring constantly for 8-10 minutes.
steps.tr: Pirinç keklerini ve balık keklerini ekleyip sürekli karıştırarak 8-10 dakika pişirin.
steps.es: Agregar los pasteles de arroz y pescado; cocinar 8-10 minutos removiendo.
steps.de: Reiskuchen und Fischkuchen zugeben; 8-10 Minuten unter ständigem Rühren einköcheln.

steps.en: When sauce is thick and glossy, fold in scallions and boiled eggs; serve steaming hot.
steps.tr: Sos koyulaşıp parlayınca taze soğan ve yumurtayı ekleyip sıcak servis yapın.
steps.es: Cuando la salsa espese, añadir cebolletas y huevos cocidos; servir caliente.
steps.de: Wenn die Sauce dickflüssig glänzt, Frühlingszwiebeln und Eier unterheben; heiß servieren.
